summary: Fresh Baguette’s official Georgetown page confirms the exact location, while its restaurant-issued chain menu provides the current food and nonalcoholic product boundary. The frozen catalog mixes current products, duplicate size/presentation rows, prior seasonal items, and ordering-only offerings. Repeated sizes are consolidated, stale rows are removed, and current omissions are added. All four allergen search classes were completed without finding an official allergen matrix; ingredient-derived positives are preserved conservatively and undisclosed allergens remain accurately unavailable.
